concept.th-file.def: A named bundle of bytes on storage, which you can find again by its name.
concept.th-folder.def: A named group of files, arranged in a tree you walk to reach a file.
concept.th-permissions.def: The rules the operating system checks before it lets a program open or change a file.
concept.th-device.def: A piece of hardware - keyboard, screen, printer, network - that programs reach only by asking the operating system.
